claude.performance_metric: Chapter 11 filed May 20, 2020; Section 363 sale of substantially all assets consummated Oct 1, 2020 (100% credit bid, all common stock cancelled), deregistered Oct 2, 2020
claude.rationale: The slice documents Akorn's realized trajectory as a standalone SEC-reporting company — recurring operating losses ($226.8M net loss FY2019), going-concern doubt, a chapter 11 filing, and a Section 363 asset sale to term-loan lenders with common stock cancelled — but it explicitly contains no information about any prior transaction's structure or about integration of an acquired product with operating processes. There is therefore no realized-outcome evidence of a product/process interface disruption (p4) or of an operations-versus-organization fracture (p5); the documented failure is a financial-distress/bankruptcy outcome rather than a described integration breakdown at those interfaces. Because the slice does not permit distinguishing these specific integration pathways from generic financial failure, both p4 and p5 are coded uncertain.

grok.performance_metric: Ch.11; substantially all assets sold via §363 credit bid; stock cancelled Oct 2020
